restore_steps: Keep auth profile, OAuth state and master token on private encrypted persistent volume; do not commit
Use original stable public hostname if possible because OAuth state is tied to its issuer
Restore into test container isolated from the internet, confirm file permissions and profiles
Use dedicated Google account, read operator security guide
Test remote OAuth flow, NotebookLM server_info and read-only notebook listing before reconnecting clients
red_flags: Changing public domain may break issuer-bound tokens
Cloudflare Workers Free is not a persistent container runtime
